table.title: 02. Performance of the time targets at courts of appeal (turnaround time 75 percentile in months). Year 2014-2025.

samples.label: 02. Performance of the time targets at courts of appeal (turnaround time 75 percentile in months) by Court of appeal, Category and Year
note: The table illustrates the performance of the time targets at the courts of appeal set by the government, measured in months at the 75th percentile for cases determined during the selected time period (time from filed case to determined case) except for civil cases, time from filed case to decision delivered regarding leave to appeal where the decision regarding leave to appeal was given during the selected time period).

The target for Criminal cases excluding priority cases is 5 months, the target for Civil cases (time from filed case to decision delivered regarding leave to appeal) is 2 months and the target for Civil cases where leave to appeal has been granted is 10 months.

Priority cases are criminal cases involving a detained person or a defendant under 18 years of age, these cases shall be handled promptly. Cases at the Patent and Market Court of Appeal (a part of Svea Court of Appeal) are also excluded.
